title: Recalled abduction aboard a 50-foot craft and toe implantation

tellings.quote: Um well they um two um uh gray small gray beings uh came into my room and um woke me up and said come outside.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels of his own recalled abduction in Fillmore, California. He says two small gray beings came into his room, woke him and said "come outside," and that he was taken aboard a craft about 50 feet across, where something was implanted in his toe. If true, his own body would be part of the evidence he studies.
